newsitem.title: USA: Avecor files to market cardioplegia system.
newsitem.headline: Avecor files to market cardioplegia system.

text.p: Avecor Cardiovascular Inc said Wednesday it has filed an application with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration, seeking clearance to market its new MYOtherm XP cardioplegia delivery system.

Pending FDA clearance, the company intends to introduce the MYOtherm XP to the United States market during the second half of 1997. The product, used during open heart surgery. will be introduced to the company's European sales force and distributor network late in the second quarter of this year, Avecor said.
